{{Top|leg}}
'''Light absorbing cells''' were invented and used by the [[Kerestian/Legends|Kerestian]] people in their [[darkstick]]s.

They were applied as an integrated webbing along a darksticks surface, and upon activation the cells would bend light by using an [[Electromagnetic field/Legends|electromagnetic field]], creating a "darkness field" in the darkstick's vicinity. Kerestian's wore [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] and [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]] scanners into battle as a result, taking advantage of their opponents blindness to savage effect.
